create_biarm_model: create a bi-arm MuJoCo XML model from a single-arm wxai_follower.xml specification
build_biarm_spec: build a bi-arm MjSpec with left and right arm copies attached at separate worldbody sites
generate_biarm_xml: generate a bi-arm MuJoCo XML string with contact excludes and equality constraints injected
attach_arm_to_site: attach an MjSpec arm copy to a worldbody site with a name prefix for left or right arm
couple_gripper_joints: add equality constraints coupling left and right carriage joints for synchronized gripper motion
